review: DAENEM Staff Portal Printing workflow boundary review

findings.summary: Printing relationships and attached file retrieval could trust cross-company or cross-job references, exposing mismatched customer, service, employee, location, inventory, or file metadata.
findings.correction: All affected reads and writes now repeat the authoritative Printing company or print-job relationship, active employee membership, active location, file category, job key, and R2 metadata boundaries; invalid references fail neutrally.

findings.summary: Operational Printing viewers could receive or write commercial fields including prices, balances, quotes, material costs, finishing costs, profit, and finance notes.
findings.correction: Commercial responses and writes are permission-composed from Printing approval or company-scoped Finance view authority; ordinary operational viewers receive no protected financial fields or finance notes.

findings.summary: Edit-level users could approve artwork, enter commercial or terminal job states, or rewrite artwork/proof status through a generic transition.
findings.correction: Approval-sensitive actions now require Printing approval authority, and the generic status transition no longer accepts artwork/proof state overrides.

reviewer.result: PASS for the bounded Printing authorization, relationship-integrity, financial-disclosure, file-binding, and transition-governance change; authenticated V45 browser acceptance remains pending.
